selection.method: Python random.Random(440404) over BTCUSDT 2022-01-01..2025-11-20 seven-day windows; exclude every previously opened candidate-04 week by at least 42 days and keep selected weeks at least 56 days apart
selection.engine_contract: Every weekly and long evaluation must run through NautilusTrader BacktestNode, execution engine and portfolio/accounting. No custom fill, position, fee or PnL simulator is admissible evidence.

staging_contract: Open only nt-week-1 first. Open nt-week-2 only after the unchanged candidate passes all first-week gates. Open nt-week-3 only after week 2 also passes. Start no long evaluation unless all three pass unchanged.
